- Auto clicker (Toolkit, and a Quick Settings tile): a floating bar with − / + for how many spots (1 to 10), start / stop, the speed (0.1 to 5 s) and close; each spot is a target mark you drag to where the tap should land, and while it runs the marks let the touch through. Needs the Pulse · Auto clicker accessibility service (it reads nothing from the screen). The tile opens the accessibility settings until the service is on, then shows the bar, then starts and stops.
- Weather: the background is now a drawn scene instead of a plain sky: mountains, sea, city, forest, street or highland, under the sky of the hour (sunrise, morning, noon, afternoon, sunset, dusk, night; sun and moon move across by the real sunrise and sunset), with clouds, rain, snow (white hills and roofs), fog and storm on it. Each scenery has its own sky colours (violet mountains, teal sea, red-orange city, green forest, bright highland) and little movements (birds, fireflies, a boat, chimney smoke, blinking lights, swaying pines). Weather settings > Scenery: Random (default, changes every few hours), By my region (high ground is mountains or highland, low ground the sea, the rest city or forest), or one you choose.
- New widget Weather, scenery (2x2 and up, resizable): the same picture with the place, the temperature, the condition and the high and low on it.
- New widget Weather, scenery has a preview in the widget picker and in the launcher.
- The Cloud and Cloud light looks are gone.
- Keyboard password manager: the list showed at most 40 logins even with hundreds saved; it now lists them all (the count at the top is the real one) and scrolls.
- Windows 11 and Windows 7 launcher windows: the blurred desktop behind a window now covers the whole window; it was shifted (a picture bigger than the window is centred by a bare requiredSize), so only the middle of the window had the blur.
- Windows 10 and 11 start menus on a turned screen: the menu keeps its own width (the width limit was ignored, so it filled the screen) and its live tiles are shorter, so the apps under them show.
- Windows desktop windows: a touch on a window now brings it to the front even when what is inside takes the touch.
- Windows 7, XP and 95: the Settings entry opens the Control Panel (a Windows 10 style Settings window titled Settings did not belong there).
- Windows Media Player skin on a turned screen: the cover is no longer larger than a part of the window, the glow of the ground lights both ends (the left end was too dark and the right bare) and the control bar lies on a band across the whole window.
- Desktop widgets (Windows looks): hold a widget and drag it at once (no small grip to hit); a tap still opens the widget's own app, and the desktop clock opens the phone's Clock app. Widgets follow the icon grid: their first size is whole grid cells and they settle on the cell lines. Launcher settings > Widgets on the grid (off: place and size them freely).
- Keyboard effects: new key press effect RGB keycap: a ring of moving colours (with a soft glow) round the pressed key's own cap, as RGB edge does round the whole keyboard.
- Keyboard space bar: the walking figure now looks the way it walks (it went backwards), you can type your own emoji or letters or pick a picture for it, and a Turn it round switch sets any figure straight.
- Keyboard key caps: give any key a colour of its own (swatches or red, green and blue) or a picture, or take a ready set (Rainbow, Sunset, Ocean, Candy, Forest, Mono, Neon) that colours the whole board. Keyboard settings > Space bar picture / Key caps.
- Windows start menus (XP, 7, 10, 11): the shut-down button now offers every way out: Sleep, Lock, Shut down, Restart and Sign out (shut down and restart really act with root or Shizuku; without them the phone's power menu opens).
- Weather scenery: ten more sceneries (four mosques: hilltop, grand domes with a pool, village, seaside with a bridge; three villages: snowy, terraced, windmill farm; three deserts: caravan, oasis, red canyon). The random choice now fits the weather and the hour (snow picks snowy places, rain a city, street or the sea, fog a forest or the coast) and mosques are the commonest.
- The moon: a real moon everywhere (the weather page, the weather sceneries and skies): its face with the seas and craters, lit by tonight's true phase, the night side faintly lit by the earth instead of a flat dark disc. New widget Moon phase (1x1 and up; taller shows the phase and its light).
- Widgets may now be put on the lock screen where the phone allows widgets there (Samsung lock screen widgets, Android 15 tablets).
- Contacts: WhatsApp, Beeper and other apps can open a contact in Pulse Contacts from its picture (QUICK_CONTACT), and on Samsung a new contact is saved in the phone's own account so the dialer and the messaging apps see and name it.
- Keyboard: a blocked suggestion is a slip, never a word: it leaves the learned words (it counted as a word and was never corrected) and the keyboard finds the word it was meant to be, mends it at once next time, and learns which keys the finger slipped to (o for ı, ğ for ü, p for o, ş for i, t for y …); the commonest slips cost least. The blocked list from before is read the same way. E-mail addresses on the list are left alone.
- Weather scenery: ten new places, each its own: Everest with prayer flags and snow blowing off the summit, a jungle waterfall with a parrot, a neon city in the rain, a mushroom-house village, the northern lights over an igloo, a savanna with giraffes, Mount Fuji with a pagoda and falling sakura, a lavender field with bees, a smoking volcano with lava, and a tropical island. The random choice spreads over all of them by the weather (snow: Everest, northern lights; rain: neon city, jungle …).
- Contacts on Samsung: contacts saved earlier without an account (Samsung's Phone app showed only their numbers and its Info did not open them) are moved into the phone's own Phone account when Pulse Contacts opens, with all their details.
- Keyboard: a missed space bar (c, v, b or n typed where a space was meant, as in açılanvekran) is mended into the two words; a for s and r for e count among the owner's slips.
- LocalSend (nearby sharing): phones now find each other on the same Wi-Fi and through a hotspot: Pulse stays visible while it runs (new Always visible switch, on), not only while the LocalSend page is open; a phone that finds another tells it about itself so both list each other; the announcement goes out on every network (the hotspot's own included) and again every minute.
- App manager > Debloat > Reinstall: it now lists the apps the system itself reports as removed for this user, including the ones removed earlier with Canta or pm uninstall --user 0 (it only knew those Pulse had seen leave). Bringing one back still needs root or Shizuku.
- Series and movies: each episode is downloaded under its own name (Dexter S05E02), not the torrent's file name; magnet links and Stremio links are handled through a new switch that is off by default (Downloads > Series and movies > Magnet links as torrents), and the picks of a series are never blocked by it.
- Terminal neofetch: the card follows the real neofetch (ZeroTermux): green labels, white values, green logo, white user, green host, the two rows of colour blocks at the foot.
- Weather: the page-wide scenery has a soft shade under the cards so towers and roofs do not run through the text.
- YTXTube: the quality list is a clear glass panel at the right of the screen.
- Installer: one APK opens in the same floating window as an APK opened from outside; XAPK, APKS and APKM files (and APKs a file app calls a plain file) open in Pulse from file apps.
- Game Hub: games hidden outside Pulse with pm hide (Clash Royale, Clash of Clans and other games) are listed, so they can be shown or hidden.
- Auto clicker: the page is a small white note card.
- Crash fix (#14): scrolling pages in Toolkit and the music Recap are given a finite height cap, so "vertically scrollable component measured with infinite max height" cannot happen there.
- YTXTube: swipe up/down on the left side changes brightness, on the right side volume, and the swipe keeps going while you hold (it used to stop with the hold-speed wait); the screen stays on while a video plays; the Library no longer has the Series and movies card.
- Widgets: a Photo frame widget (a square tile with a photo of your own, fill or fit, rounded corners, border; its settings open when placed and when tapped) and Notes now show on the Widgets page; the launcher calls them gadgets.
- Series and movies: downloads are normal links unless "Magnet links as torrents" is on (it is off by default).
- Auto clicker: the target is a small half-transparent white dot with a black outline, and the floating bar can be dragged from any of its buttons.
- PDF search: the up/down arrows scroll to the found word itself, not only to its page.
- Files, wide screen: the list view has a button to go back to the columns; the columns have the filter and sort options at the right; files saved with Save to appear in Recent.
- YTXTube: pulling the video down follows the finger (the player shrinks as you pull and settles on release; pull part way and go back to full size). Files columns slide in when they open. The extra apps' launcher icons have a lighter blue background.
- Keyboard: the learned words are saved once, a few seconds after a burst of typing, instead of every 25 words (typing was slow after a long message).
- Files: the plain list shows names only (also on a tablet); sizes and dates belong to the Detailed list. "Sizes and dates" in the menu still turns them on in the plain list.
- Game Hub: hidden games are no longer dropped from the lists when the app cannot see them (the shell is asked first); Termux and other tools are never hidden by Game Hub (and are shown again if they were); the opened case is drawn at the screen's own pixels so it is sharp.
- Game Hub: the Hidden list also shows apps hidden outside Pulse (visible without root; switching them on again needs root or Shizuku).
- Game Hub, Select games: games on this phone first, then the hidden games (also the ones hidden outside Pulse; with root the shell is asked too), then every other app (a switch puts it in the library). The built-in games are no longer in this list.
- Keyboard: the next-word suggestions now follow the whole sentence before the cursor (the neural model weighs the candidates), not only the last two words.
- App manager: apps hidden outside Pulse (pm hide from a shell or another tool) are listed too, marked hidden.
- Weather: the rain is fine, short and dense (sized by the screen width, not a tenth of the page); the jungle waterfall is drawn again (rock walls, a narrow fall with short streaks, a foaming pool) and the vines are short.
- Keyboard: the language model also exists in Rust (native/kbdlm): same results as the Java model on the test sentences, about four times faster; the build adds it to the APK and the keyboard uses it, with the Java code as the fallback.
- Game Hub boxes: the back cover takes the front cover's own average colour (as the spine band already does), so front, spine and back read as one box.
- Game Hub: the opened case is drawn sharper, and steps back to the normal size by itself when the frames run slow, so the extra pixels never cost smoothness.
- Series and movies: a stream the add-on gives only as a torrent downloads with the torrent engine in Pulse when Stremio is not running on the phone (its local link only works with Stremio open).
- Widgets: a Contacts widget (a tile that opens the Contacts app) on the home screen and in the lock screen list.
